none: PAS KENT-806EA6: Early constantinian voti altar nummus
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete highly worn Roman copper-alloy nummus (AE3) of the early years of The House Constantine (317-330). Probable 'BEAT(A?) TRANQLITAS', Altar VOTIS reverse type, uncertain mintmark dating to the period c. AD 321-324 (Reece Period 16). Obverse: Laureate cuirassed bust right. Legend: '[___VS P AVG]'. Reverse: Altar VOTIS XX. Legend: Illegible, likely 'BEAT(A?) TRANQLITAS'. Measurements:…
